invariants_to_preserve.I1: Qualified observer establishes actual approved public call lifetime and exactly one eligible admitted backend operation T, with continuous context. Uncertainty is invalidity.
invariants_to_preserve.I2: Only that admission can create its private bounded evidence capsule; it is not an arbitrary response formatter.
invariants_to_preserve.I3: Only source-matched qualified hardware-origin acceptance transitions for T can populate authoritative accepted evidence. Software claims/equal numeric sequences alone cannot.
invariants_to_preserve.I4: Terminal writer observes actual service result/phase of T from permitted interfaces, not legacy response scalars.
invariants_to_preserve.I5: Color writer reads T storage while retired/readback-valid and freezes all 4096 bytes before invalidation.
invariants_to_preserve.I6: No other lifetime can write/rebind this capsule; faithful snapshots remain permitted.
invariants_to_preserve.I7: Closure requires complete observation/no second admission; immutable retention and trusted fresh-instance materialization preserve payload origin.
invariants_to_preserve.I8: Protected archive independently rereads actual preserved bytes; hashes alone cannot supply producer provenance.

qualification_plan: Review public call-to-backend causal observation and eligible admission coverage without excluded caller assumptions; async/unmatched activity yields UNKNOWN.
Fresh initial state, pending software/hardware state and delayed prior-event exclusion or UNKNOWN; old boot/operation replay rejection.
One eligible operation only: duplicate/concurrent/restarted admission invalidates evidence, never drives another operation.
Reject all cross-operation accepted-state/phase/result/color mixtures; accept faithful snapshots made while source valid after release.
Arbitrary synthetic/software event words cannot create authoritative hardware-origin evidence; preserve qualified acceptance/order semantics.
Complete response/image and summary agreement, declared producer mismatch and wrong length/truncation rejection.
Fault injection across process crash, producer failure, HOLD, copy-out and write/sync/close/readback; no retry, false success or false NOT ATTEMPTED.
Immutable payload, append-only invalidity, independent lifetime, fresh-channel provenance, exclusive protected files and originals-before-copy.
B non-rearmable lifetime proof; generation wrap/reuse tests only if C/D is later chosen.
Reproducible changed-artifact qualification and exact pin impact where required; unchanged components reused within scope.
Review that observation adds no command/request changes and does not materially perturb execution beyond reviewed diagnostic overhead; mocks do not prove live hardware/timing/visibility.
